app.notFound.home.description: Button back to the Overview page

app.notFound.subtitle.defaultMessage: There is nothing at this address. Check the link, or start from the Overview.

configEditor.enrollment.qrDuplicates.defaultMessage: {keys}: use the setting above instead. Once that is set, it wins over this entry.

configEditor.enrollment.qrInvalid.defaultMessage: Not valid JSON yet. It is saved as typed; the Enroll page leaves it out until it is fixed.

configEditor.enrollment.qrLong.defaultMessage: These entries are long ({bytes} bytes): the enrollment QR code gets dense, and may not fit at all.

configEditor.enrollment.qrSettingInvalid.defaultMessage: “{value}” isn't a value Android takes here, so it is left out of the code. Choose one from the list.

configEditor.enrollment.qrUnusedInvalid.defaultMessage: {keys}: not used. The value isn't of the type this entry takes.

configEditor.enrollment.qrUnusedProtecte.defaultMessage: {keys}: not used. MDMesh sets these itself.

configEditor.enrollment.qrUnusedUnsuppor.defaultMessage: {keys}: not used. MDMesh passes on only these setup entries: {known}.

configEditor.enrollment.qrUnusedWifi.defaultMessage: {keys}: not used. Wi-Fi comes from the setup Wi-Fi above and the Enroll page.

configEditor.enrollment.setupScreensHelp.defaultMessage: Android applies these while the device sets itself up.

enroll.qrSize.dense.defaultMessage: This code holds {bytes} bytes, so it is dense: some devices' setup cameras may struggle to scan it. A shorter server address or Wi-Fi, or fewer Extra QR parameters, make it lighter.

enroll.qrSize.tooLarge.defaultMessage: This code would hold {bytes} bytes, more than a QR code can ({max}). The server address (it is in the code twice) or the Wi-Fi is too long: shorten them.

enroll.qrSize.tooLargeFrame.defaultMessage: No QR code: it would be too large to scan.

enroll.setup.notLoaded.defaultMessage: Not added: the configuration didn't load, so the code has none of its setup entries

enroll.setup.others.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# other entry} other {# other entries}}

enroll.setup.serverDefault.defaultMessage: Not added: choose a configuration to add its setup entries (the page can't tell which one is the server default)

enroll.setup.unsupported.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# entry left out} other {# entries left out}}: not a setup entry MDMesh passes on, or a value of the wrong type

enroll.setup.wifiLeftOut.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# Wi-Fi entry left out} other {# Wi-Fi entries left out}}: Wi-Fi comes from this page (and the configuration's setup Wi-Fi)
